project_type: Python FastAPI backend with async provider architecture, React TypeScript frontend
build_system: Python venv (.venv), pip for dependencies, npm for frontend (not modified in this phase)
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests
verification_instructions: 1. Activate venv: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\activate. 2. Run specific test file: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_<module>.py -v. 3. Run all tests: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/ -v (38 existing tests must still pass). 4. Check imports: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -c 'from app.providers import SofaScoreFootballProvider, DataQualityEngine, SourceIntelligence'
environment_constraints: Backend venv at backend/.venv must be activated for all Python operations. Never use global Python. SofaScore API is unofficial/reverse-engineered - implementation must handle rate limits and failures gracefully. DevelopmentProvider must remain untouched (used by 38 existing tests).
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md Rule 2: Always read files before editing. Rule 3: Never delete working code without justification. Rule 6: Run tests after changes. Rule 7: Never claim 'implemented' or 'tested' without verification. Rule 10: Never invent statistics. Rule 19: No external AI APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc). Rule 23: Fix errors instead of reporting them. Rule 24: Complete phase before moving to next.
key_patterns: Provider pattern: async class with __init__(base_url, timeout_seconds, retry_count, cache), async close(), _request() method with ProviderError exception handling, normalize methods that convert raw API responses to ProviderXxx models. All providers use ProviderCache with TTL constants (LIVE_DATA_TTL=30, UPCOMING_FIXTURES_TTL=300, etc). All responses include source metadata: provider, source_id, fetched_at, source_updated_at, is_live, data_freshness_seconds. ProviderManager uses SOURCE-OF-TRUTH rule: once a provider returns non-None, that's final - no field-level failover. Manager has routing constants: NORMAL_ORDER, LIVE_ORDER, MATCH_DETAIL_ORDER, METADATA_ORDER.
directory_structure: backend/app/providers/ contains provider implementations. backend/app/api/v1/ contains REST API schemas. backend/tests/ contains 38 existing test files (pytest). frontend/ not modified in this phase. docs/PROGRESS.md tracks implementation progress.
